verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~34% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~-1% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.7% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 41 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 57 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Profit fell 79% last year, which inflates PE; check whether the drop is cyclical (temporary) or structural.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 21% a year while PE moved 57 → 41.
